title: claims.json
description: Rules for factory/bin/claims.sh (WO-20261012-0677): the files no feature PR may carry, the paths every PR may add, the branch exempt from the files check, and the doc number series that must be unique.

aggregates.description: Generated or per-seat files, bash globs where * crosses /. A diff that adds or changes one fails; deleting one is allowed (untracking).

implicit.description: Paths any ticket may add without declaring them: each entry is a new unique file.

exempt_branches.description: Branch globs whose diff is not checked against a ticket (the architect records PR).
